title: Noel 2013 · Full-body audiotactile PPS conference series
citation: Noel, J.-P., Galli, G., Blanke, O., & Serino, A. (2013). Audio-tactile multisensory integration as a proxy for full body peri-personal space. Multisensory Research, 26 Supplement, 181.
notes: The conference abstract supports comparison-level inspection. Experiment boundaries, participant cohorts and individual schedules require the source methods.

published_method.source_scope: Proceedings abstract summarizes a series of at least two experiments, with no exact formal count or mapping of the comparisons to cohorts.
reported_comparisons: Separation of the hand from trunk
published_method.later_primary_publications: A later formal publication can clarify how its own paradigms were implemented. The abstract gives no cross-reference establishing which complete later methods and participants correspond to each conference comparison.
